The '''Krayiss Obelisk'''<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> was an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifact,<ref name="darkside" /> dating back to sometime prior to [[28,000 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> Housed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Krayiss II]], the obelisk was used as the gateway for accessing a&mdash;likewise age-old&mdash;Sith [[library-temple]]. It was encountered by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Vara Nreem]] when she arrived on Krayiss Two in an attempt to communicate with the Sith.<ref name="darkside" />
